notes:
I couldn't do this research, so I have no notes for you yet. My first attempt to fetch the sources was refused with the message "You have no more code_execution tool calls remaining this turn." That's my only route to the web, so I didn't read any pages.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point and leave out anything I couldn't find. With nothing read, I can't write any of the three parts, and I haven't written notes from memory instead.

If you send the request again in a new turn, these are the pages I planned to start with:
- **Enduring Word (David Guzik):** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-107/
- **Precept Austin:** preceptaustin.org/psalm-107-commentary
- **Bible Hub verse pages (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Matthew Henry and others):** biblehub.com/commentaries/psalms/107-1.htm through 107-22.htm
- **Spurgeon's *Treasury of David*:** on spurgeon.org, ccel.org or studylight.org
- **Wesley's *Explanatory Notes*:** wesley.nnu.edu
- **NET Bible translator's notes:** netbible.org
- **Augustine on the Psalms (this psalm is Psalm 106 in his Latin numbering):** newadvent.org
- **Other views:** searches on catholic.com, oca.org and bibleodyssey.org, plus a search for prosperity or word-of-faith uses of v. 20 ("He sent forth His word and healed them")
